title: 第25章 天魔门－夜伏天第26章 直接秒有什么好说的
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
“陆师兄，这万青山中真有魔宗活动？”
“听说魔宗之人会拿修士炼丹，抽筋扒皮制作法器，行事邪恶残暴，也不知道有没有那么离谱。”
一众青云宗弟子从宗门山上下来，自从进入筑基期之后都是飞剑赶路没有时间闲聊。今天倒是个难得的机会，众人慢慢赶路，自然要找点应景儿的话题。
“都闭嘴！”陆长天冷哼一声，淡漠的眼神瞥了眼身后一众弟子，淡淡道：“就算有魔门之人又如何？这万青山是我们青云宗的地盘，哪怕是魔门老祖来了也得盘着！”
众弟子闻言纷纷露出恭维的神情。
“陆师兄说的对！”
“是啊，陆师兄可是我们青云宗新一代亲传弟子的最强者，天赋不比那些魔门弟子高多了？”
“要是碰到魔门弟子我们直接大开杀戒！”
陆长天闻言表面上面无表情，但心里还是有点小爽的。
没错，之前有宗主亲传赵凌天压在他头上，现在赵凌天丹田被废，他就是年轻一代亲传弟子中的第一人，青云宗最强筑基期，区区魔门……
呼——！
晴朗的夜空突然晦暗下来。
陆长天抬头，只见一片乌云从山中升起遮掩了月色，以极快的速度朝着西边飞去。
那乌云中涌动着猩红的魔气，即便隔着很远都能感觉到令人脊背发寒的威压。
“是魔修！”
“好恐怖的魔气！”
“快通知宗门！”陆长天脸色苍白，全然没了之前的得意。
魔气都已经化云了，对方保底都是个老妖怪。
与这样的老妖怪撞上，他们这些金丹期都不到的小修士不是找死么？
陆长天身边的执法堂弟子手忙脚乱地拿出传音玉简，刚要启动，却发现身体无法动弹！

“桀桀桀，小娃娃，可不能让你们随便传递消息。”
阴森的笑声在身后响起。
陆长天亡魂大冒，发现空中的黑云已经消失不见。
那魔修居然不知何时已经来到他们身后。
魔气迷雾将那名执法堂弟子吞噬，连惨叫都没发出来，连带着那玉简也被捏成碎片。
“老夫今日有急事，没时间料理你们，就给你们一点小玩具玩玩儿吧~桀桀~”
魔气逐渐散去，那魔修甚至都没有真正露面就已经击杀一名青云宗筑基期弟子，原地只留下一具面目狰狞的干尸。
“他、他走了？”
“张师弟，张师弟？”
“唉，别喊了，死透了！赶紧回宗门汇报吧！”
传音玉简只有一个，况且万青山有大魔修出现，已经不适合他们这种战力的弟子继续执行任务了，必须由宗门派出更精锐的弟子甚至派出长老来解决问题。
一名弟子上前，正要给名为张师弟的倒霉蛋收尸。
“别过去！快回来！”
陆长天紧盯着那尸体已经察觉到一丝异样，赶紧提醒，但还是晚了一步。
只见死透的张师弟周身突然长出红毛，接着从地上瞬间弹起，迅猛如猎豹般扑向那名弟子，血盆大口张开，露出上下两对锋利的獠牙，照着那弟子的脖子就啃了上去。
噗嗤——！
一名筑基期弟子的脖子居然就这么被直接啃断，
脖子连着半截血肉，血涌如注。
突如其来的一幕将周围的弟子一个个都吓懵了，不知所措地愣在那里。
而那见了血的怪物气势却变得更加狂暴。

“这是毛僵！”陆长天拔出腰间的飞剑，神情凝重，赶紧对左右弟子吩咐：“速速结阵，敌人棘手，若是不杀了它我们谁都别想跑！”
content_en:
"Senior Brother Lu, are there really demon sect activities in Wanqing Mountain?"
"I heard that people from the Demon Sect would use monks to make elixirs, peel off their skin to make magic weapons, and behave evilly and cruelly. I don't know if it's that outrageous."
A group of Qingyun Sect disciples came down from Zongmen Mountain. Since they entered the foundation building period, they were all in a hurry and had no time to chat. Today was a rare opportunity. Everyone was hurrying on their way, so naturally they wanted to find some topic that suited the occasion.
"Shut up!" Lu Changtian snorted coldly, glanced at the disciples behind him with indifferent eyes, and said calmly: "So what if there are people from the Demon Sect? This Wanqing Mountain is the territory of our Qingyun Sect, even if the ancestor of the Demon Sect comes, we have to keep it!"
All the disciples showed compliments after hearing this.
"Senior Brother Lu is right!"
"Yes, Senior Brother Lu is the strongest among the new generation of direct disciples of our Qingyun Sect. Isn't his talent much higher than those of the Demon Sect's disciples?"
"If we encounter any disciples of the Demon Sect, we will immediately kill them!"
Lu Changtian was expressionless on the surface when he heard this, but he was still a little happy in his heart.
That's right, Zhao Lingtian, the sect master's direct disciple, was weighing on him before. Now that Zhao Lingtian's Dantian has been abolished, he is the first among the younger generation of direct disciples. The Qingyun Sect's strongest foundation-building period, a mere demon sect...
Phew——!
The clear night sky suddenly darkened.
Lu Changtian looked up and saw a dark cloud rising from the mountain, covering up the moonlight, and flying towards the west at an extremely fast speed.
Scarlet demonic energy surged in the dark clouds, and one could feel the spine-chilling pressure even from a long distance away.
"It's a demon cultivator!"
"What a terrifying demonic energy!"
"Inform the sect quickly!" Lu Changtian's face turned pale, and his previous pride was completely gone.
The demonic energy has already turned into clouds, and the opponent is guaranteed to be an old monster.
When they collide with such an old monster, aren't these little monks who have not yet reached the golden elixir stage looking for death?
The disciples from the Law Enforcement Hall next to Lu Changtian hurriedly took out the sound transmission jade slip and were about to start it, but found that their bodies could not move!
"Jie, Jie, Jie, little doll, I can't let you just pass the news."
Eerie laughter sounded behind him.
Lu Changtian's soul emerged, and he found that the black clouds in the sky had disappeared.
The demonic cultivator unexpectedly arrived behind them.
The mist of demonic energy swallowed up the Law Enforcement Hall disciple, without even letting out a scream, and the jade slip was crushed into pieces.
"I'm in a hurry today and don't have time to take care of you, so I'll give you some toys to play with~ Jie Jie~"
The demonic aura gradually dissipated, and the demonic cultivator killed a Qingyun Sect foundation-building disciple without even showing up, leaving only a hideous-looking mummy on the spot.
"He, he's gone?"
"Junior Brother Zhang, Junior Brother Zhang?"
"Oh, stop shouting, you're dead! Go back to the sect and report!"
There is only one sound transmission jade slip, and there is a great demon cultivator appearing in Wanqing Mountain. It is no longer suitable for disciples with their combat power to continue to perform tasks. The sect must send more elite disciples and even elders to solve the problem.
A disciple stepped forward and was about to collect the body of the unfortunate guy named Junior Brother Zhang.
"Don't go there! Come back quickly!"
Lu Changtian stared at the corpse and noticed something strange, so he quickly warned him, but it was still a step too late.
I saw the dead Junior Brother Zhang suddenly sprouting red hair all over his body, then he instantly jumped up from the ground and pounced on the disciple like a cheetah. He opened his bloody mouth, revealing two pairs of sharp fangs, and gnawed on the disciple's neck.
Pfft——!
The neck of a foundation-building disciple was actually chewed off directly.
The neck was connected to half of the flesh and blood, and blood was pouring out.
The sudden scene frightened all the surrounding disciples, and they stood there at a loss.
But the monster's momentum became even more violent after seeing the blood.
"This is Mao Zhan!" Lu Changtian pulled out the flying sword from his waist, with a solemn expression, and quickly ordered the disciples on his left and right: "Hurry up and form a formation. The enemy is very difficult. IfUnless we kill it, none of us can escape! "
